Item.Name: S_PICK_SLIP_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter pick slip type or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select code, code_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_desc
 from vserv_pick_slip_types
 where code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date, sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('7305'); -- Invalid pick slip types
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 
 select distinct ord.customer_id, cu.name
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_name
 from v_all_ord_ship vos, orders ord, customers cu
 where vos.pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and ord.order_no = vos.order_no
 and cu.customer_id = ord.customer_id
 and ord.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and vos.chapter_id = ord.chapter_id
 and cu.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and rownum=1;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 end;
 if :s_pick_slip_type = 'TR'
 
 then
 go_block('pick_products');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query(NO_VALIDATE);
 :system.message_level := 0;
 else
 go_block('pick_slip_products');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query(NO_VALIDATE);
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_id := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_name := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_insert_date := '';
 --select pick_slip_id, insert_date -- Commented by Kishore on 01/22/2015. IM 10345
 --select pick_slip_id, lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id, insert_date) -- Added by Kishore on 01/22/2015. IM 10345
 select pick_slip_id, lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, insert_date) -- IM 15
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_insert_date
 from pick_slips
 where (:ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_status is null
 and pick_slip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id)
 or (pick_slip_status = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_status
 and pick_slip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id);
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('3300'); -- Invalid pick_slip id
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID
 :pick_slip_products.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:pick_slip_products.unit_id,
 :pick_slip_products.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select product_short_name
 into :s_product_short_name
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:pick_slip_products.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:pick_slip_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0309'); -- Invalid product code
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc --HCL substr(abo_desc,1,6)
 into :s_blood_type_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :pick_slip_products.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:pick_slip_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0300'); -- Invalid blood type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select substr(code_desc,1,15)
 into :s_product_status_desc
 from vserv_product_status
 where code = :pick_slip_products.product_status;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('3305'); -- Invalid product status
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID
 :pick_products.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:pick_products.unit_id,
 :pick_products.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select product_short_name
 into :s_product_name
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:pick_products.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:pick_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0309'); -- Invalid product code
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select abo_desc --HCL substr(abo_desc,1,6)
 into :s_type_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :pick_products.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:pick_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0300'); -- Invalid Blood Type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select substr(code_desc,1,15)
 into :s_status_desc
 from vserv_product_status
 where code = :pick_products.product_status;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('3305'); -- Invalid product status
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select c.short_name
 into :s_source
 from pick_slips ps, orders o, consignee c
 where ps.pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = o.order_no
 and ps.chapter_id = o.chapter_id
 and ps.source_hospital = c.consignee_id
 and ps.chapter_id = c.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('1300'); -- Invalid Consignee Id
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_PICK_SLIP_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT pick_slip_id, lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, insert_date) insert_date
FROM pick_slips
WHERE (:ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_status IS NULL
 AND pick_slip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type
 AND chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 )
 OR (pick_slip_status = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_status
 AND pick_slip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_type
 AND chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id)
ORDER BY insert_date, pick_slip_id
